items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: The name 'Julian' is mentioned by the interviewer in the context of leaving an audience together, but the interviewee does not respond to or elaborate on any relationship with Julian.

ctx.x: What was it like when you joined the band? Where is it? Were you all alone? Were you all alone? Were you all alone? Were you all alone? playing occasionally on a record, but not big bands apparently. Right. Not that I just like the one I've heard. It is, it is. I just wondered why I looked at it. What was it like when you joined the band? Where?
We all left in the audience together. You all left in the audience? The band was organized in the audience. That's how we left, Julian. And, uh, Don had a job in Dallas at the States.
